Albie.test

    

      
About

      
For the love of golf.

      
Albie is an open source caddie. It reads everything ever written, filmed or mapped about a course, argues with itself like a tour caddie, and hands you ranked ways to play the shot in front of you.

    

    
    

    
Every glyph is real course data. Run your finger through it.

    

    

      
How Albie thinks

      

        
01Ingest. Official hole guides, tour coverage, caddie videos, member forums, OpenStreetMap geometry.

        
02Triangulate. Nothing counts on one source. Conflicts get flagged, never merged.

        
03Compile. Everything becomes IF situation THEN advice, per hole, per tee, per pin.

        
04Personalize. Your carries, misses and weaknesses re-rank every option. Never a club you can't hit.

        
05Learn. Your call ratings and rounds become ground truth in the next update.

      

    

    
    

      
The short game

      
Inside 40 yards Albie switches to the chip engine: it reads your lie, the green speed and the slope at the green, picks runner, pitch or high-soft, and marks the exact landing spot on the map. Putting stays yours. No green-reading theater.

    

    

      
Honesty, by design

      
Every fact carries a source tag and a freshness date. Confidence is computed, not claimed: check any course's trust card. What Albie doesn't know is displayed, never hidden.

    

    

      
What's coming

      
Built in the open, in this order. Your testing is the fuel: every rated call and exported round decides what ships next.

      

        
01A caddie that learns you. Your logged rounds become habit memory: keep coming up short with the 8-iron and Albie starts handing you the 7.

        
02Smarter math under every call. Strokes-gained scoring on the options, aim points set by your real miss pattern, wind drift drawn on the map.

        
03GPS, field-tuned. The auto-follow round gets tightened on real walked rounds. Every GPS round you play is tuning data.

        
04More courses, including yours. Request any course below. The local tracks nobody writes yardage books for get built with the people who play them.

        
05Round history and your numbers. Score trends and personal stats per course, straight from the card you already keep in the Log.

        
06Full open source. The app first, then the whole ingestion pipeline once the licensing sweep is done.
